title: AltaGas - 2027 Business Analyst & Planning Co-op Student
description:
Job Description
# of Positions : 1
Start Date: January 2027
Duration: 8 Months

About the Role
Interested in using data to support business planning, capital portfolio governance, and operational decision-making?

AltaGas is seeking a Business Analytics & Planning Co-op Student to join our Operations Planning & Analysis team. In this role, you'll support the management of the Midstream Maintenance Capital (MCAP) portfolio, G&A planning and governance, reporting, forecasting, and analytics initiatives that help business leaders make informed decisions across the organization.

You will work with operational, financial, workforce, and capital portfolio data to support planning processes, improve reporting accuracy, and provide meaningful business insights. This role is ideal for students who enjoy working with data, collaborating with stakeholders, building reports and dashboards, and contributing to process improvement initiatives.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Corporate teams, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting capital governance, business planning, demand planning, and continuous improvement initiatives across the business.

What You'll Do
Capital Portfolio Governance & Planning

- Support the administration and governance of the Midstream Maintenance Capital (MCAP) portfolio.

- Assist in maintaining capital portfolio databases containing actual and forecast spending information.

- Help prepare and organize supporting documentation for Authorizations for Expenditure (AFEs).

- Track portfolio performance metrics and maintain reporting packages for capital programs.

- Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, and Finance teams to ensure capital information is complete, accurate, and up to date.

- Support portfolio reviews, forecasting activities, and investment planning discussions.

Reporting & Analytics

- Support the maintenance, validation, and enhancement of Power BI dashboards and reports.

- Create visualizations, summaries, and presentations that communicate key business insights to leadership teams.

- Analyze data from multiple systems and sources to identify trends and opportunities.

- Assist in investigating reporting discrepancies and data quality issues.

- Maintain reporting documentation, business definitions, and data dictionaries.

- Help prepare recurring operational, financial, and management reporting packages.

G&A Governance & Financial Planning

- Support G&A planning, reporting, and governance processes.

- Assist with labour allocation analysis across operating assets and capital projects.

- Help gather, compile, and organize planning inputs from stakeholders.

- Perform variance and trend analysis to identify risks and opportunities.

- Maintain planning templates, documentation, and supporting analysis.

Demand Planning & Continuous Improvement

- Support the development of demand planning and integrated planning processes.

- Assist with data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting related to demand planning initiatives.

- Document business processes and workflows using Microsoft Visio or similar tools.

- Support process improvement initiatives that enhance planning, governance, and reporting effectiveness.

- Contribute to projects that connect operational drivers, resource demand, and financial outcomes.

What You'll Bring

- Currently enrolled in a post-secondary degree program in Business, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science , or a related field.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large datasets and identify meaningful insights.

- Experience using Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and data analysis techniques.

- Experience with Power BI and data visualization tools is considered an asset.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Curiosity and a desire to understand how operational and financial decisions are made.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Excellent collaboration and relationship-building skills.

- Experience with JD Edwards, Workday, Power BI, or financial systems is considered an asset.

- Interest in business planning, capital investment governance, operations, or energy infrastructure is an asset.

What You'll Gain

- Hands-on experience supporting capital portfolio governance and investment planning.

- Exposure to G&A planning, forecasting, workforce planning, and business analytics processes.

- Experience working with operational, financial, and capital portfolio datasets.

- Exposure to AltaGas' integrated planning and demand planning initiatives.

- Opportunities to collaborate with professionals across Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Corporate functions.

- Experience using Power BI, Excel, reporting tools, and business planning processes.

- Mentorship from experienced professionals and opportunities to build your professional network.

- Meaningful project work that directly supports operational performance, capital investment decisions, and business planning.

title: WGL – Gas Transmission Engineer (Level I, II, III or IV)
description:
Job Description
WGL – Gas Transmission Engineer (Level I, II, III or IV)

Washington Gas has an immediate need for a Transmission Engineer to provide design and engineering support for the Engineering group and Gas Transportation.   Civil Engineering is highly preferred.  **Washington Gas will hire at Level I, II, III or IV depending on the candidate's experience

You Will:

- Manage transmission and high pressure large-diameter distribution pipeline projects of small to moderate scope including route analysis and selection, pipeline design, project cost estimating, coordinating easement acquisition and permitting, material identification & acquisition, construction specifications, assistance with contractor bid and selection process, construction management support, restoration and documentation activities.

- Manage budget and provide cost/schedule forecasts for projects mentioned above. Assist with the development and justification of annual capital budget items. Provide weekly MOS reports.

- Provide civil engineering design function for the entire Corporate Engineering and GT Unit.

- Provide overall engineering support for operating and maintenance and special projects.

- Provide engineering assistance for the development of new or updating of existing O&M procedures as well as Design & Construction standards.

- Provide project support for or manage large-scale or complex transmission/distribution piping projects.

- Provide analysis of complex loading scenarios on existing transmission and high pressure distribution pipelines.

- Provide support for or manage civil/structural projects within WGL process facilities.

You Must Have:

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering preferably in Mechanical or Civil

- A general knowledge of related engineering disciplines and applicable codes and standards.

- Demonstrated ability to establish rapport and effective working relationships with internal and external business partners.

- Proven ability to use computer software and applications, including Microsoft Office, for data management, research, analysis, and reporting purposes.

Engineer Level I

- 0-2 years of engineering experience

Engineer Level II

- 1-2 years of relevant experience in the natural gas or related industry required.

- “Engineer-in-Training” (EIT) Certification preferred.

- "Project Management Professional" (PMP) Certification preferred.

Engineer Level III

- 3+ Years in the natural gas industry or related industry is required

- Engineer-in-training (EIT) Certification is required, or

- "Project Management Professional" (PMP) Certification required

- Professional Engineering (PE) Certification is preferred, or

- GTI CGTP for Transmission Certification is preferred

Engineer Level IV

- 5+ years in the natural gas industry or related industry is required

- Engineer-in-training (EIT) Certification is required, or

- GTI CGTP for Transmission Certification is required

- Professional Engineering (PE) Certification is preferred

We offer a competitive salary range of $66,000.00 to $130,000.00 per year, commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition, we provide a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.

The Company values diversity in its workforce and encourages United States military veterans and service members who meet the qualifications to apply

Why work at AltaGas?
AltaGas  is a North American energy infrastructure company with a focus on owning and operating assets that provide affordable energy to our customers. AltaGas assets include Washington Gas/WGL, SEMCO, and Petrogas. Our talented team, nearly 3,000 strong, leverages the strength of our assets and expertise along the energy value chain to connect customers with premier energy solutions – from the well sites of upstream producers to the doorsteps of homes and businesses to new markets around the world.
We deliver clean and affordable natural gas to approximately 1.7 million customers’ homes and businesses through regulated natural gas distribution utilities across four jurisdictions in the United States and two regulated natural gas storage utilities in the United States. Learn more about our team, vision, and strategy.
To learn more about our mission:  https://youtu.be/k1mrKDdsYW8?si=y1k3NOyHxgf4emdL
#LI-DG1

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to a person's ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, record of offences, marital status, family status or disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

For U.S. hires : WGL/SEMCO/AltaGas offers a total rewards package that includes competitive pay, incentive bonus plans, holiday pay, 401K matching and a wide array of benefits. These benefits including medical, dental and vision coverage are designed to help you and your family stay healthy. We also have paid time off (PTO) to balance the demands of your work and personal life. Available benefits vary depending upon the specifics of the role.
